{{Quote|Respect Voss.|Vana-Xo|<ref name="The Pain of Healing" />}}
'''Vana-Xo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Voss Mystics|Voss Mystic]] on [[Voss]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Proficient in the art of healing, she tended to the injured at the [[Shrine of Healing]]. Around [[3640 BBY]] [[Madaga-Ru]] send the [[Empire's Wrath|Emperor's Wrath]] to Vana-Xo so that she could bestow the [[Blessing of Oneness]], required to enter the [[Dark Heart]] in the [[Nightmare Lands]]. Vana-Xo tried to ask the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] for a measure of the life force that could be used to heal the injured. The Wrath refused the offer, but received the Blessing nonetheless.<ref name="The Pain of Healing" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Wrath has three options to gain the Blessing of Oneness. They could accept and offer their strength, or they could offer the strength of a companion, or they could threaten to kill Vana-Xo. Any option will result in the Wrath gaining the blessing.<ref name="The Pain of Healing" />
